name: Mounted
source:
Step onto the mats and into a world where strength isn’t just physical—it’s about heart, connection and self-discovery.

You play as Dan, an everyday guy with no athletic background, but a curiosity for Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. More comfortable behind a screen, watching memes, he never saw himself as the kind of person to step onto a mat—until now. Drawn to the challenge, he throws himself into training at Rainbow BJJ, a gym known for being a safe and inclusive space for fighters of all backgrounds.

Beyond the training, Dan finds himself pulled into the lives of those around him—fellow fighters with their own histories, struggles, and ambitions. Rivalries ignite, friendships form, and the lines between training partners and something more begin to blur. He never expected to find love on the mats, but the more he grapples—physically and emotionally—the clearer it becomes: this journey isn’t just about learning Jiu-Jitsu. It’s about discovering who he really is.

Will he rise to the challenge, both on and off the mats? Or will he tap out before the real fight even begins?

[From [url=https://frotty.itch.io/mounted]Itch.io[/url]]
